acc.validate: The system checks every field entered against its stated constraints.
acc.integration: The system retrieves and shows the data automatically through the integration with «{p}», as section «{sec}» states.
acc.sections: The «{s}» stage screen shows these sections of the {request}: {list}.
acc.formSections: The system shows these screen sections: {list}.
acc.previous: The «{s}» stage screen shows every action and decision taken at the «{p}» stage.
acc.actions: At this stage the system offers the actions in the actions table below, each with its effect on the {request}.
acc.afterSubmit: The system shows the {request} number and status after sending.
acc.rework: The system shows the {customer} the review notes and lets them change the data and attachments before sending again.
acc.output1: The system creates the «{output}» with the required data once the {request} is finally approved.
acc.output2: The user can view the «{output}» and download it as a PDF.
acc.output3: The «{output}» carries the {request}'s serial number in the format section «{sec}» states.

fr.dynamicFields: The system shows the required fields dynamically by user type and permissions.
fr.validate: The system validates the fields entered and blocks sending before every required field is filled in.
fr.attach: The system lets the {customer} attach the required documents, shows what was attached, and allows changing or deleting them before sending.
fr.submitCancel: The system lets the {customer} send or cancel the {request}.
fr.confirm: The system shows a confirmation message with the {request} number after a successful send.
fr.integration: The system integrates with «{p}» to retrieve {data}.
fr.integrationNoData: The system integrates with «{p}» to exchange the data section «{sec}» states.
fr.toPayment: The system takes the {customer} to the payment stage once the required data is filled in.
fr.afterPayment: The system moves the {request} to the «{t}» stage once the payment is confirmed.
fr.autoAssign: The system assigns the {request} automatically to an officer of the «{t}» stage as soon as it arrives.
fr.rework: The system lets the {customer} change the {request} when it is returned, and send it again.
fr.track: The system lets the {customer} follow the status of their {requests}.
fr.notes: The system lets staff add notes to the {request} and hide them from the {customer} when needed.
fr.history: The system shows the action log of the {request} to every user concerned.
fr.notify: The system notifies the {customer} when the {request} status changes, with the {request} number, status and date.
fr.output: The system creates the «{output}» after final approval and lets the {customer} view and download it.
fr.timer: The system ends the {request} automatically when the «{s}» stage is not completed within {d}.
fr.deskActions: The system lets {w} take these actions on the request: {list}.
fr.branchGate: The system shows the «{f}» field only when {when} is chosen.
